# Install wedge on Alpine Linux 3.20

> Tested on 2026-10-31 with wedge 0.1.1 in a clean `alpine:3.20` container () by `scripts/test-install.ps1`. The service-manager step is not run there (containers have no init system); wedge runs as the `wedge` user instead.

## 1. Prerequisites

```sh
command -v curl >/dev/null || sudo apk add curl
command -v openrc >/dev/null || sudo apk add openrc
```

## 2. Download and verify

Download the package and the checksum list from the GitHub release, and check the
package before installing it. Never pipe a download straight into a shell.

```sh
VERSION=0.1.1
BASE=https://github.com/alinganpatra20004/wedge/releases/download/v$VERSION
curl -fLO "$BASE/wedge-${VERSION}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz"
curl -fLO "$BASE/SHA256SUMS"
grep " wedge-${VERSION}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz$" SHA256SUMS | sha256sum -c -
```

The command must print `OK`. You can also check the build provenance:

```sh
gh attestation verify wedge-${VERSION}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz --repo alinganpatra20004/wedge
```

## 3. Install

```sh
tar -xzf wedge-${VERSION}-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl.tar.gz
sudo install -m 0755 x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/wedge /usr/local/bin/wedge
sudo addgroup -S wedge && sudo adduser -S -D -H -G wedge -s /sbin/nologin wedge
sudo mkdir -p /etc/wedge/conf.d /srv/www
sudo cp x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/examples/www/default/index.html /srv/www/
printf '[server]\nlisten = ["127.0.0.1:8080"]\ndefault_vhost = "default"\n\n[[vhost]]\nname = "default"\nroot = "/srv/www"\n' | sudo tee /etc/wedge/wedge.toml >/dev/null
sudo chown -R root:wedge /etc/wedge && sudo chmod 0750 /etc/wedge && sudo chmod 0640 /etc/wedge/wedge.toml
sudo install -m 0755 x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/openrc/wedge /etc/init.d/wedge
```

## 4. Configure

The default configuration serves a test page on `127.0.0.1:8080` only. Edit
`/etc/wedge/wedge.toml` (see the [configuration reference](../guide/configuration.md)),
then check it:

```sh
sudo wedge check-config -c /etc/wedge/wedge.toml
```

## 5. Start

```sh
sudo rc-update add wedge default && sudo rc-service wedge start
```

## 6. Check

```sh
curl -I http://127.0.0.1:8080/
```

Expect `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` and an `x-content-type-options: nosniff` header.

## Reload after configuration changes

```sh
sudo rc-service wedge reload
```

## Remove

```sh
sudo rc-service wedge stop; sudo rc-update del wedge default
sudo rm /etc/init.d/wedge /usr/local/bin/wedge
```
